scenarios.event_description: Black Monday II: COVID crash. S&P 500 fell 12% in a single session. VIX spiked above 80. Federal Reserve cut rates 100 bps in emergency action.
Black Monday II: COVID crash. Banking sector under acute stress. Loan-loss provisions expected to spike.
Black Monday II: COVID crash combined with oil price war. WTI crude fell below $30/bbl.
Fed rate shock: CPI at 8.5% (40-year high). Fed signalled aggressive rate hiking path. Growth stocks under pressure from rising discount rates.
Fed rate shock: rising rates benefit bank net interest margins but increase recession risk. Mixed signal for financials.
Fed rate shock + Russia/Ukraine: energy prices elevated, sanctions creating supply disruption. Macro tailwind for energy sector.

AAPL Q1 FY2023 earnings beat: EPS $1.88 vs $1.94 estimate — slight miss on EPS but beat on revenue. Services growth strong. Stock rallied +2.4% after hours. Provides a positive earnings surprise test.
